claim.claim-text: 1. A handheld fluid delivery device (10) comprising:
2. The handheld fluid delivery device of claim 1, wherein the electrode assembly further comprises a conductive tube through which the fluid flows toward the at least one nozzle.
3. The handheld fluid delivery device of claim 2, wherein the conductive tube is configured to apply an electrical charge to the fluid prior to the fluid passing through the at least one nozzle.
4. The handheld fluid delivery device of any preceding claim, wherein the reservoir is removable from the housing.
5. The handheld fluid delivery device of claim 4, wherein the reservoir is removably attached to the housing (110) by being at least partially slidable along a surface of the housing.
6. The handheld fluid delivery device of any preceding claim, further comprising a light source positioned adjacent to the at least one nozzle.
7. The handheld fluid delivery device of claim 6, wherein the light source is positioned at a front end of the housing.
8. The handheld fluid delivery device of claim 6 or claim 7, wherein the light source is configured to emit light towards a direction in which the at least one fluid is expelled.

9. The handheld fluid delivery device of any preceding claim, further comprising at least one actuator (1805) positioned so that a user can actuate the handheld electrostatic device (10) with a finger.
10. The handheld fluid delivery device of claim 9, wherein the at least one actuator (1805) is positioned in the portion of the housing to be handheld by a user.

11. The handheld fluid delivery device of any preceding claim, wherein the electrically conductive portion comprises a groundwire or other structure (1815) in the portion of the housing to be handheld by a user.
12. The handheld fluid delivery device of any preceding claim, wherein the at least one nozzle provides a cone-shaped spray pattern of the fluid.
